title: Does text() emit OSC 8 hyperlinks for links?
body:
`text()` in `src/lib.rs` turns laid-out rows into ANSI strings. Since 5ee4fd2 it wraps each link's text in an OSC 8 hyperlink escape (`ESC ] 8 ; ; target ESC \` … `ESC ] 8 ; ; ESC \`) when `color` is true, and skips a target that holds a control character. Plain output has no escapes. foam's CLI prints markdown through `text()`, so a link in a foam issue becomes a clickable hyperlink in terminals that support OSC 8. foam's writing rules discourage links today.

## Options

- Keep OSC 8 on whenever colour is on. Terminals without support ignore the escape.
- Make it a separate switch, so an app can have colour without hyperlinks.
- Drop OSC 8 and draw link text underlined only.

Jack decides. Nothing in foam's current issues contains a link, so foam's output does not change either way today.
